notes: Source: official ARRI "SkyPanel S60-C" Product Information datasheet (Ident.-No. 80.0006856, Sept 2022), www.arri.com. Ports listed are on the lamphead unit itself. The S60-C is typically sold with a separate external Power Supply Unit (PSU) that has its own powerCON TRUE1 AC input (100-240V~) and a female 3-pin XLR 48V DC output to the lamphead plus a powerCON TRUE1 mains-through pass-through connector — that PSU is a distinct physical unit (not the fixture itself) and was not modeled as a port here. No rack unit size applies; this is a hand-held/yoke-mounted soft light fixture (28mm Junior spigot mount), not rack-mountable. No product category/type in the given enum precisely fits a lighting fixture, so category "other" / type "Other" were used. All connector grades were intentionally omitted because the datasheet does not specify a DMX/Ethernet link speed or USB generation.

ports.name: Power In (48V DC, from PSU)
ports.note: Male 3-pin XLR, 15A, Pin1 negative / Pin2 positive. Carries 48V DC from the external PSU, not audio. No dedicated 3-pin DC connector id exists in the allowed list, so xlr3 was used as the closest match.

ports.name: Battery In
ports.note: Male 4-pin XLR, 10A, Pin1 negative / Pin4 positive. On-board battery input, 23-36V DC (industry-standard V-mount/Anton-style DC connector).

ports.name: EtherCon (LAN)
ports.note: Locking Neutrik etherCon network port for DMX-over-Ethernet, Art-Net, sACN, and PC/Mac control software. Datasheet does not state link speed, so no grade was assigned.

ports.name: USB-A
ports.note: For firmware updates via flash drive; can also power small USB devices (~500mA @5V per secondary source). USB generation not stated in the datasheet, so no grade was assigned.
